Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted which “Permission to Fly” the question referred to and conflated multiple works with the same title. Despite evidence pointing to Jordan Pruitt’s 2008 album (on Hollywood Records), the Planner pivoted to Jordan Rudess, even incorrectly asserting a 2019 track on Wired for Madness. This disambiguation error led the process down the wrong branch and produced the incorrect label (Inside Out Music) instead of Hollywood Records.
